name: AgentGuardBench
description: AgentGuardBench v0.1.1 is an open, reproducible multilingual benchmark for evaluating privacy, security and responsible behaviour in tool-using AI agents. The report documents 120 fully synthetic cases across six risk categories, five sectors and four languages. It presents deterministic strict and permissive baseline policies, machine-readable metrics, limitations, ethics guidance and a roadmap for real-model evaluation. The results validate the benchmark and scoring pipeline; they are not claims about any commercial or production model. The accompanying software is archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23127436. Correction note: This version corrects the DOI in Reference 1 to 10.5281/zenodo.23048250. No benchmark data, methods, or results changed.
